newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Nov CPI up 4.8 pct yr/yr, 0.5 pct mth/mth.
newsitem.headline: Thai Nov CPI up 4.8 pct yr/yr, 0.5 pct mth/mth.

text.p: The Thai consumer price index (CPI) rose 4.8 percent year-on-year in November and 0.5 percent month-on-month, the Commerce Ministry said on Tuesday.
Commerce Minister Narongchai Akrasanee said the CPI index grew 5.9 percent in the first 11 months. He did not give the comparison data for the same period in 1995.
The ministry said the 1990-based index rose to 136.4, up from its 130.1 level in November 1995.
The 0.5 percent month-on-month increase compared with a 0.5 percent rise in October over September, the ministry said.
The index rose 4.3 percent year-on-year in October.
